summary: Frontend smoke-tested on http://localhost:3001/login. The OfficeFlow login screen, fields, submit control, and input interaction work; same-origin API requests are emitted, but /api/settings/public returns the frontend HTML/404 path instead of reaching the backend.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/settings/public on port 3001 returned HTTP 404 in the browser (the direct response is the SPA fallback HTML), causing console 404s and forcing default branding. The frontend emits the required relative /api URL, but the preview server is not routing it to the backend.

action_items: Configure the port-3001 preview/ingress route so same-origin /api/* requests proxy to the backend instead of falling through to the React app.
Retest /api/settings/public and the login submission after routing is corrected.
critical_code_review_comments: The browser-relative axios base URL is correct for the requested integration, but craco.config.js has no local development proxy; port 3001 therefore cannot satisfy relative /api routing by itself.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login route and controls pass at port 3001. Recheck same-origin /api proxying first; public settings returned 404 twice in Playwright and produced browser console errors. No source files were changed.
rca of the issue: AppSettingsContext calls api.get('/settings/public'), which resolves to /api/settings/public in the browser. The frontend dev server on port 3001 has no proxy configuration and falls back API requests to index.html/404 behavior, so branding settings cannot load through the required relative route.
